title: Turkey meatballs with spaghetti
summary: Lean turkey meatballs simmered in a garlicky tomato sauce and piled onto a modest bowl of wholewheat spaghetti, finished with a little Parmesan.

steps.instruction: Mix the turkey with half the garlic, half the oregano, half the salt and plenty of pepper. Roll into 12 walnut-sized balls. Wetting your hands stops the mince sticking.
steps.tip: Cold mince rolls more cleanly. Don't pack the balls hard or they turn dense.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil in the frying pan over a medium heat. Brown the meatballs on two sides, then lift them onto a plate. They do not need to be cooked through yet.

In the same pan, soften the onion and carrot for 4 minutes. Stir in the remaining garlic, the passata, remaining oregano and a splash of water. Nestle the meatballs back in, cover and simmer until they are cooked through.
steps.tip: If the sauce looks thick, loosen it with a tablespoon of the pasta water.

steps.instruction: Meanwhile boil the spaghetti in plenty of salted water until tender with a little bite, then drain. Toss it with the sauce and meatballs and scatter over the Parmesan.
